assertions.assertion: The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has recurrent episodes of syncope
The symptoms are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring
A cardiac event monitoring study is indicated for extended rhythm assessment
The diagnosis code I48.0 is assigned
The diagnosis code R55 is assigned
The CPT code 93271 is indicated for the cardiac event monitoring study
The service is medically necessary because intermittent symptoms and recurrent syncope require extended monitoring to detect the underlying arrhythmia responsible for the collapse
